fields.Name: T72 - Learning Course Enrollments
fields.Description: Verifies a Course's related Enrollments can be reached from the full record form and that enrollment rows render.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Courses' entity from the entity tree. Select the course 'CHZ-101 Cheesemaking Fundamentals' (or any course) and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full course form. On that form, locate the related Enrollments section/tab and view the enrollments, confirming enrollment rows are displayed. Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Course full record form is open showing course detail fields
The related Enrollments section/tab is visible with enrollment rows (or a valid empty-state for a course with no enrollments)
The enrollments grid shows member or status columns
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
